Limits: No native document edits. All poses compose actual nested occurrences into the optical-local frame.

Full-tip criterion conservatively requires the complete nominal lock diameter to fall within unchamfered rod shaft. Failure is reported separately from centerline contact and does not constitute a force/preload analysis.

LCP33 locks use an offset clamping slot, not the custom clamp radial tip mechanism. Native four M4 screw solids are explicitly located; their axial band coverage is diagnostic, not a contact-pressure certification.

Native rods can contain factory-installed removable 4-40 studs. Self-intersection within the same supplier rod is not classified as an assembly interference. Every rod body is checked against all other hardware except explicit reference rays.
